method: Brad Frost’s atomic design: parts and whole refined concurrently. Tokens are foundations beneath atoms, not a sixth UI stage.

implementation: No duplicate state where HTML already owns it
qualification: Keyboard, focus visibility and dialog focus return
Opaque control surfaces: text 4.5:1; functional boundaries/marks 3:1
At least 44px control hit targets as Anima policy
Screen-reader pass; real touch and browser/device coverage
Full-page flow and moving-background contrast review
